headline: Celestis
title: How to Get Celestis and Stellarys | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Celestis is easy to find. It roams widely across the Forest of Falling Stars, and you can also meet it in Nimbus Fields, the Argent Strait and Echoback Landing. Stellarys is the harder one. The basic Stellarys does not spawn in the wild. Raise a Celestis to level eighteen, then defeat the Alpha Stellarys to unlock the evolution. Have you beaten it? Comment below!

scenes.sub: Widespread in the Forest of Falling Stars

description: Celestis spawns across several regions and evolves into Stellarys at level 18 after you defeat the Alpha Stellarys.
